The following events took place in '''30 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]] is replaced by [[Horace Vancil/Legends|Horace Vancil]] due to ideological differences between Greejatus and influential [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the foremost world in the sector.<ref name="DB Greejatus">{{DB|character|janusgreejatus|Greejatus, Janus}}</ref>
*[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] begin the hunt for [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]].<ref name="HfAS">''[[Star Wars: The Hunt for Aurra Sing]]''</ref>
*[[Vergere]] is dispatched to investigate [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]; she offers to go with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
*[[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] released from [[Force Stasis/Legends|stasis]] by [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] overrun [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]].<ref name="D">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref>
*The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] passes legislation requiring the disbanding of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] security forces.<ref name="HNN Baktoid">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|business/1337_1.html|Baktoid Closes Down Five More Plants}}</ref>
*At the age of seventeen, [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] enlists in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] infiltrates [[Krayn]]'s organization. {{Circa}}<ref name="Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>
*[[Kh'aris Fenn]] attempts a coup on the [[Twi'lek Ruling Council|Twi'lek Clan Council]].<ref name="Star Wars 1998 21">[[Star Wars (1998) 21|''Star Wars'' (1998) 21]]</ref>
*[[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]] abandons [[Engebo V]].<ref name="DDD">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20011018a|text=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter|int=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter}}</ref>
*[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] acquires a set of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] plating from her master, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], and installs the plates on [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="ACVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
*The [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]] is created.<ref name="MotPQ">''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]''</ref>
